subject: Fix size stat in malloc(0) and cleanups around zmalloc file (#13068)
reason: The only behavioural line (size = MALLOC_MIN_SIZE(size) in zmalloc's prefix-size accounting) is compiled only when HAVE_MALLOC_SIZE is undefined, i.e. no jemalloc/tcmalloc/macOS and no libc malloc_usable_size; the fuzzer's Linux builds (jemalloc or glibc) never compile that path. The rest of the diff is comment fixes, an include swap, and a rewrite of the REDIS_TEST-only zmalloc unit test, which is what covers the malloc(0) stat fix and is not reachable from a running server. Even where the fix compiles, the effect is a few bytes in the internal used_memory stat, visible only via INFO memory,
